seo.title: Retail Cosmos — One platform. Every store.
seo.description: Launch your own storefront on Retail Cosmos. Multi-tenant ecommerce with self-serve signup, isolated data, layout studio, and Razorpay checkout.

hero.lead: Retail Cosmos is multi-tenant ecommerce — each merchant gets their own storefront, catalog, and theme on shared infrastructure.

stores.titleGray: Fashion, market, tech — each tenant keeps its own brand and catalog.

studio.title: Customize without rebuilding
studio.lead: Store layout studio controls home, catalog, header, footer, and colors — same platform, unique look per tenant.

cards.title: Isolated tenants
cards.body: Products, orders, theme, and customers stay separate per store — on one shared commerce engine.

cards.title: Catalog & checkout
cards.body: Variants, bulk import, cart, wishlist, and Razorpay payments ready for every storefront.

cards.title: Share-ready products
cards.body: WhatsApp share with Open Graph previews so product links show image, name, and price.

items.title: Launch a store
items.body: Pick a name and URL, then list products the same day — no custom infrastructure.

items.title: Grow the catalog
items.body: Bulk import, banners, and layout controls scale as inventory grows.

items.title: Run many brands
items.body: Operate multiple storefronts from one platform with tenant isolation.
